body: Ports docs/reference/vector_cache.md's real mechanics faithfully: Merkle-style per-node content hashing (not simplified away, per the item's own instruction), flat brute-force cosine-similarity search (IndexFlatIP-equivalent, exact search not a shortcut), hit/miss stats. Honest v0 scope cut: ships only StubEmbedder (deterministic, sha256-based, explicitly NOT semantically meaningful) since a real embedding model/service is real follow-up work, not faked here -- pluggable Embedder interface makes that swap-in a zero-change-to-Cache operation later. Deliberately doesn't own an LLM client or credentials (Lookup/Add are separate calls, caller owns the sequence) -- stays a pure caching layer. 19 tests including -race clean. Verified end-to-end with a real demo: 2 hits/3 misses/40% hit rate over 5 queries, access counts and stats all correct. Commit 2953b21.
title: S150-02 v0: vectorcache -- semantic LLM-context cache, Go port
